nodes.name: Patient-7
nodes.summary: Patient-7, born November 17, 1967, case number URO-2026-0007, managed by Dr. med. Arzt-1 at the Urologische Klinik of Klinikum Berlin, had metastasized C61 Prostatakarzinom with a Gleason score of 4+5=9 (ISUP 5) and staging cT3b cN1 cM1b. Treatment involved chemotherapy and nuclear medicine using Radium-223 therapy. PSA levels measured 14.1 ng/ml on April 22, 2028, 18.3 ng/ml on May 20, 2028, and 23.5 ng/ml on June 17, 2028, indicating biochemical progression. On September 4, 2028, the patient presented with severe bone pain and fatigue, an ECOG performance status of 4, and exhausted curative options, leading to a shift to palliative care with WHO step 2 analgesia and Best Supportive Care. Patient-7 passed away on September 22, 2028, at Klinikum Berlin due to progressive metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
